title: Foldable Water Container 8L – with Tap
descriptionHtml:
Keep clean water close to the tent

At the campsite the tap is far away, and heavy water jugs take up space. You want water close at hand without hauling back and forth.

Collapsible and easy to carry

This water container holds almost 8 liters and has a handy tap. When it's empty, you fold it flat so it barely takes up any space.

Features

  • Holds almost 8 liters
  • Handy tap for easy dispensing
  • Foldable – takes up little space
  • Easy to carry along
  • Great for camping, hiking and outings

14 days to change your mind. Counted from the day you receive the item.
